## Bounded-scope decisions (recorded honestly)

- **Savannah rides the AgendaCenter, not AgendaPlus.** The I9b-C016
  candidate host has no bounded public index; the same jurisdiction's
  serving council agenda surface (`savannahga.gov/AgendaCenter`) is the
  CivicPlus contract this row lands — the tenant binds there and the
  AgendaPlus host is censused, all recorded on the rows.
- **CivicPlus `catAgendaRow` items are meeting-level.** The row carries one
  meeting's agenda link + date; per-agenda-item detail stays out (P8-3 —
  matter metadata only; no document fan-out declared, so `discover_more`
  yields nothing for the HTML contracts).
- **Fargo background/consent links are attachments**, never items — the
  archive parser emits one item per table row (its `Agenda Only` link);
  minutes/video links never qualify.
- **`startDateTime` is the documented normalization** of each captured
  US/month-name date literal to ISO 8601 (the meeting_date claim's typed
  value); the verbatim literal stays in `raw_meeting_date` + `raw`.
